description.value: Vonns is a casual sit-down restaurant on Denman Street in Vancouver's English Bay neighbourhood, a stone's throw from the Stanley Park seawall — one of the most popular cycling corridors in BC. The menu focuses on smash burgers, birria tacos, and Philly-style cheesesteaks, drawing on the founder's culinary travels through Australia and Southeast Asia. The beachfront setting and outdoor patio make it a natural stop for cyclists finishing a seawall loop.
